_comment: Second-reading glosses for the Wechselpräfix verbs the app drills. AUTHORED here: the English gloss and the register tag only. Separability, Partizip II and auxiliary are DERIVED from wiktionary-cache.tsv by generate-dual-section.py and never written here. Keyed by Partizip II so the generator can match a gloss to a reading without guessing. Glosses are paraphrased from the de.wiktionary sense lines of the matching reading (fetched 2026-08-28), not invented.

durchdacht.en: to think sth through in all its aspects

durchgedacht.en: to think sth through step by step to the end

durchgegangen.en: to go through; to go over sth point by point

durchgangen.en: to traverse, cross through a space

hintergangen.en: to deceive sb, go behind their back

umfahren.en: to drive around sth, avoid it

umgefahren.en: to knock sth over by driving into it

umgegeben.en: to put sth around sb, e.g. a scarf

unterhalten.en: to entertain; to converse; to support financially

übergelaufen.en: to overflow; to defect to the other side

überlaufen.en: to overrun sth, swamp it — of crowds

übergelegt.en: to lay sth over sb, e.g. a blanket

übergesehen.en: to grow tired of seeing sth
